checks.q: Is the UserOperation signature validation complete and non-bypassable?
Is the Paymaster properly validating which operations it sponsors?
Are storage access patterns compliant with ERC-4337 restrictions?
Is the account initialization protected against front-running?
Are social recovery guardians properly configured and secured?
Is the EntryPoint address verified against the canonical deployment?
Are batch operations properly validated individually?
Is the gas estimation accurate for all execution paths?
Are session keys properly scoped with time and value limits?
Is the account upgrade mechanism properly guarded?
